verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents dozens of prebuilt connectors for carts, billing systems, ERPs and accounting platforms that keep transactions in sync after a one-time authorization. It also offers a REST API/SDK transaction sync (L1) with a recommended backfill window covering the previous calendar year, plus CSV file upload for historical backfills, so filings can draw on multiple channels. Missing for 10: named processor/storefront connectors (e.g., which specific platforms), documentation of how multiple concurrent sources are consolidated or deduplicated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
